checks.reason: Explains limits of existing input/IgG controls, but does not prospectively specify a complete role-defined positive, negative and procedural control comparison for its proposed biological validation.
Inspection of source identity or omitted results is not a plan to consult detailed Methods/validated protocols and verify transfer of conditions before the proposed new validation experiment.
No measurement-reference/blank calibration, acceptance criterion and action after failed calibration for the proposed binding/association check.
No quantitative association/binding endpoint with normalization or denominator, background and weak/saturated/missing-signal handling.
A negative endogenous/purified assay does not convert unsupported into contradicted without validated assay function, sensitivity and condition coverage.

Independent techniques are proposed, but an operational comparison with remaining uncertainty is incomplete; endogenous association plus cell-free binding does not alone establish direct contact in the native cellular context.
